name: Question 3
problem: Chantelle did an experiment in her Chemistry class. She heated a liquid whose initial temperature was $-{5.3}^{∘}\,\text{C}.$ After several minutes, the temperature of the liquid increased by ${24.7}^{∘}\,\text{C}$, at which point she decided to end the experiment. What was the final temperature of the liquid?

a

b

19.4∘C
